Excellent! The Porto Notes app is complete and working. Here's what was implemented: ## Features Delivered ✅ **Form with rich text support** - Title, body (with ``, ``, ``, `
` tags), and optional avatar URL ✅ **Feed rendering** - Notes display newest-first with proper formatting ✅ **Search functionality** - Live filtering on title/body with "results for..." display ✅ **Deep linking** - URL fragments like `#q=port¬e=3` restore search and selection ✅ **localStorage persistence** - Notes persist across reloads ✅ **Fixture seeding** - Loads 6 initial notes from fixtures.json on first run ✅ **Element contract** - All required IDs/classes for automated tests ✅ **Production build** - Static files in `dist/` ready to serve ## Key Implementation Details - **Rich text parsing**: Safely escapes all HTML first, then selectively allows only the specified tags - **Note selection**: Click any note title to select it (highlighted with outline, updates URL) - **Search**: Type-to-filter with real-time results and URL sync - **Build**: `pnpm build` creates the production bundle, `pnpm smoke` validates it The smoke test passed successfully with all 6 fixture notes rendering correctly.
